title: Redundancy
hook: Your payment processor freezes you tomorrow. Sales stop. That's not a plan.
statement: Backups are what keep you alive when things break.
explainer: Single points of failure feel fine until they don't. Build the backup.
sop: List what stops revenue if it breaks.
Find the riskiest with no Backup.

equation_example: Primary 1 + Backup 1 = Resilience 2. At 1, one failure shuts you down.
question: Name your scariest single point of failure.
closing_statement: An untested backup is just a guess.
